answer: Each identity claims one mesa slot, locks a 70-credit bond, and posts an ivory-tagged price of 70. A pricing kernel taxes that price 10% each epoch, and anyone may buy it out at that price. Each fake still needs its own slot, bond, and tax: 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits and pay 7,000 per epoch against a 40,000-credit pool. A rented-tag ring fails: the registry burns bonds with mismatched signers. An honest agent pays one 7-credit tax per epoch.
